xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-4828: Phone app: contracts for the directory client role and sealed push frames

plan.title: Phone app: contracts for the directory client role and sealed push frames
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: The phone app epic (PAN-4823) needs shared wire types before the directory (W-CON2, W-CON3), the machine (W-MAC3) and the phone (W-WEB1) can be built in parallel. packages/contracts/src/connect.ts has only machine frames. Adding a push member to MachineToDirectoryFrame also breaks typecheck:connect, because the directory reducer's frame() switch is exhaustive with no default. And contracts test files are not typechecked in CI, so type-level rejection tests would be unenforced.
narratives.Proposal: Add ClientToDirectoryFrame, DirectoryToClientFrame, the machine push frame and the directory push-result pair to connect.ts, with CLIENT_LIMIT, CLIENT_LIMIT_MESSAGE, PUSH_RATE_PER_MINUTE, PUSH_SEALED_MAX_CHARS, PUSH_PLAINTEXT_MAX_BYTES, close code clientLimit 4013 and error code client_limit. Add an explicit case 'push' stub in services/connect/src/directory-state.ts that answers like today's bad_frame path. Test the reducer stub, round-trip every new frame, prove rejections with @ts-expect-error, add typecheck:contracts to the root typecheck so those rejections are CI-enforced, and add one sentence to docs/CONNECT-SERVICE.md. CONNECT_PROTOCOL_VERSION stays 1. Exact code is in .pan/drafts/PAN-4828.md.
narratives.NonGoals:
- No change to the decoder services/connect/src/protocol.ts (W-CON2 PAN-4829, W-CON3 PAN-4830)
- No clients table, socket roles or overdeck.bearer subprotocol auth (W-CON2 PAN-4829)
- No APNs/FCM delivery, push rate limiting or real push handler (W-CON3 PAN-4830)
- No machine-side push-result handling or native push provider (W-MAC3 PAN-4843)
- No phone-side directory client (W-WEB1 PAN-4833)
- No push-activity frame or liveActivityToken (W-IOS2 PAN-4839)
- No runtime validators, Effect Schema or runtime imports in connect.ts (it must stay runtime-import-free)
- No change to the shape of any existing frame and no change to CONNECT_PROTOCOL_VERSION
- No docs beyond the one CONNECT-SERVICE.md paragraph and the connect.ts header (W-DOC PAN-4842)
- Never commit packages/contracts/dist/

autoDecisions.summary: push joins MachineToDirectoryFrame now, with an explicit case 'push' stub in directory-state.ts frame() that answers error bad_frame 'malformed frame' plus a log effect (no default branch).
autoDecisions.rationale: The machine's directory port sends MachineToDirectoryFrame, so push must be in that union for W-MAC3; frame() has no default, so typecheck:connect fails (TS2366) without a case. The stub mirrors today's runtime answer for an undecodable frame from a registered machine.

autoDecisions.summary: push-result is typed as a discriminated pair { ok: true } | { ok: false; error: PushResultError } instead of the epic's { ok: boolean; error? }.
autoDecisions.rationale: Same JSON on the wire; the type additionally rejects ok:false without an error and ok:true with one (verified with tsc 5.9.3).

autoDecisions.summary: PUSH_SEALED_MAX_CHARS stays 3,072 (epic W-CON1) and a new PUSH_PLAINTEXT_MAX_BYTES = 2,256 is exported; the epic NFR-5 trim of 2,900 bytes is superseded for W-MAC3.
autoDecisions.rationale: 2,900 bytes seal to 3,932 base64 chars (over the cap) and an APNs body of 4,091 of 4,096 bytes; 2,256 bytes seal to exactly 3,072 chars with ~860 bytes of headroom. Recorded as a hazard and posted on PAN-4843.

autoDecisions.summary: CONNECT_CLOSE_CODES.clientLimit = 4013 and ConnectErrorCode 'client_limit' land here, not in W-CON2.
autoDecisions.rationale: Zero-runtime contract additions next to CLIENT_LIMIT_MESSAGE; W-CON2 then never edits CONNECT_CLOSE_CODES or its exact-match test on a sibling branch.

autoDecisions.summary: Client signal.purpose is the literal 'link'; client ice-servers and relay-usage reuse the machine members via Extract.
autoDecisions.rationale: The epic says a client's purpose must be link and that ice-servers/relay-usage follow the machine rules unchanged; literal and Extract typing encode both and cannot drift.

autoDecisions.summary: Add typecheck:contracts (tsc -p packages/contracts/tsconfig.json) to the root typecheck chain.
autoDecisions.rationale: Root tsc excludes *.test.ts and packages/, and the effect-diagnostics lint counts only effect() rows, so @ts-expect-error rejection tests are unenforced in CI today. The contracts tsconfig passes today in about 10 s.

autoDecisions.summary: Documentation is one paragraph in docs/CONNECT-SERVICE.md plus the connect.ts module header.
autoDecisions.rationale: W-DOC (PAN-4842) rewrites CONNECT-SERVICE.md for the client role and push; a larger edit here would only conflict.

autoDecisions.summary: The PAN-4774 sequencing gate is treated as satisfied.
autoDecisions.rationale: gh issue view 4774 reports state CLOSED on 2026-11-02.

narrative.Action: Follow PRD .pan/drafts/PAN-4828.md work item W-1 steps 1-11 exactly. In packages/contracts/src/connect.ts: extend the module header; add CLIENT_LIMIT = 5, PUSH_RATE_PER_MINUTE = 30, PUSH_SEALED_MAX_CHARS = 3_072, PUSH_PLAINTEXT_MAX_BYTES = 2_256 after APPROVAL_TTL_MS; add CLIENT_LIMIT_MESSAGE = "This account already has 5 phones. Remove one in the app or on a machine." after RELAY_CAP_MESSAGE; add clientLimit: 4013 to CONNECT_CLOSE_CODES and "client_limit" to ConnectErrorCode; add types ClientPlatform, ApsEnvironment, PushUrgency, PushResultError after SignalPurpose; add the push member to MachineToDirectoryFrame after inbox-nack; add the two push-result members to DirectoryToMachineFrame before error; append ClientToDirectoryFrame (hello-client, signal with purpose literal "link", Extract of machine ice-servers|relay-usage, push-register, push-unregister, forget-client) and DirectoryToClientFrame (welcome-client | Extract<DirectoryToMachineFrame, directory|signal|ice-servers|relay-status|error>). Only `import type` is allowed in connect.ts. In services/connect/src/directory-state.ts frame(): add `case 'push':` after the approval-cancel block returning { state, effects: [send self errorFrame('bad_frame', 'malformed frame'), log { type: f.type, environmentId: self, outcome: 'bad_frame' }] } with the PAN-4830 comment; never add a default branch. narrative.Action: Follow PRD W-2. In tests/unit/services/connect/directory-state.test.ts add describe('directory reducer: push before PAN-4830 (PAN-4828)') with two tests using the file's existing register, sends, closes, env and NOW helpers. Test 1: state = register(1); reduce(state, { kind: 'frame', registeredAs: env(1), frame: { type: 'push', requestId: '0'.repeat(32), to: '00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000000aa', sealed: 'AAAA', urgency: 'high', collapseId: '1'.repeat(32) } }, { now: NOW, online: new Set(), stunUrls: [], relayCapBytes: RELAY_MONTHLY_CAP_BYTES, turnConfigured: false }); expect result.state toBe state, sends equal one error bad_frame 'malformed frame' to self, closes equal [], and a log effect { kind: 'log', type: 'push', environmentId: env(1), outcome: 'bad_frame' }. Test 2: decodeMachineFrame(JSON.stringify(a push frame)) toEqual { ok: false, reason: 'bad_frame' }. No timers are involved.

items.title: Given a directory with one registered machine, when the reducer receives a push frame event from it, then it emits error bad_frame 'malformed frame' to self, a log with outcome bad_frame, no close, and returns the same state object
Given the JSON text of a push frame, decodeMachineFrame returns { ok: false, reason: 'bad_frame' }
Round-trip and type-level rejection tests for the new frames

narrative.Action: Follow PRD W-3. In packages/contracts/src/__tests__/connect.test.ts: assert CLIENT_LIMIT_MESSAGE text; assert CLIENT_LIMIT 5, PUSH_RATE_PER_MINUTE 30, PUSH_SEALED_MAX_CHARS 3072, PUSH_PLAINTEXT_MAX_BYTES 2256 and 4 * Math.ceil((PUSH_PLAINTEXT_MAX_BYTES + 48) / 3) === PUSH_SEALED_MAX_CHARS. Add describe('phone client and push frames (PAN-4828)') with typed fixtures (one of each of the seven ClientToDirectoryFrame types; a welcome-client and a directory DirectoryToClientFrame; a push MachineToDirectoryFrame; push-result ok:true and ok:false error 'rate_limited'); a test that the sorted client types equal the seven names; a JSON round-trip test over every fixture; a compile-time rejection test with seven single-line declarations each preceded by // @ts-expect-error (hello-client platform 'web'; hello-client without clientId; client signal purpose 'approval'; push urgency 'low'; push-result ok:false without error; push-result ok:true with error; DirectoryToClientFrame of approval-cancel) collected into an array asserted toHaveLength(7); and an assignability test from Extract<DirectoryToMachineFrame, { type: 'directory' }> to DirectoryToClientFrame. Keep each rejected object literal on one line so the directive covers the error line.
